figures.title: The many potential uses of AI in workforce benefits
figures.description: AI can enhance multiple aspects of the benefits lifecycle:

items.label: Product
bullets: Offerings designed/priced for micro-segments of the workforce
Ability to quickly create and test next-generation product offerings

items.label: Distribution
bullets: Ability to leverage data-driven bundling capabilities, materially improving relevancy for employers
Tools for employers to design purpose-built benefits programs
Proactive and automated quoting in smaller segments

items.label: Education
bullets: Immersive experiences focused on demystifying benefits offerings
Deeper insight into the unique value created across the full Wheel of Wellness

items.label: Decision support
bullets: Tools designed to help workers build custom, generationally relevant benefits packages for their unique needs
Answers the question: “What do people like me need?”

items.label: Service
bullets: Al-enabled digital agents that provide instant simple answers to complex questions
